strategies.name: ict_bias_aligned_pd_array_entry_15m_5m

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a stop raid (a low was put in before it was rated or broken).
entry_sequence.rationale: This is the first thing I focus on in my checklist.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a market structure shift or displacement (a previous high was broken and aggressively moved over).
Wait for price to move back into a discount of the price range (or premium).
entry_sequence.rationale: This is where I look for flexibility in the trade.

entry_sequence.action: Identify a PD array (Fair Value Gap, Order Block, OTE, or Breaker Block) within the discount/premium zone.
entry_sequence.rationale: I generally like to see price move back into a discount of this price range here.

entry_sequence.action: Enter the trade based on the identified PD array (e.g., Fair Value Gap, Order Block, or Box setup).
entry_sequence.rationale: I blend one, two, or three of these concepts together for my personal strategy.

stop.rationale: The stop is placed on the low/high of the identified PD array (e.g., Fair Value Gap or Order Block).

strategies.stop_management: Move stop to break-even at 1.5R, then no further management.
